sentences.en: I went to Doctor Livesey with the papers.
He was sitting with Squire Trelawney.
They opened the papers and found a map of an island.

sentences.ar: عليها إشارة حمرا وكلمة: الكنز هون.
sentences.en: On it was a red mark and a word: the treasure is here.
Trelawney said: I will buy a ship and we will go.

sentences.ar: الدكتور قال: بس لا تحكي مع حدا.
sentences.en: The doctor said: only, do not speak to anyone.

sentences.ar: وهاي بالزبط الشغلة اللي ما عملها.
sentences.en: And that is exactly the thing he did not do.
